## About

Agronomist with a Ph.D. and international experience in applied research focused on sustainable cropping
systems. Experienced in designing, conducting, and analyzing field and laboratory experiments in soil science, soil
fertility and soil health, plant nutrition, cover crops, and nitrogen management in row crops. Skilled in
experimental design, statistical analysis, data science, technical communication, and collaborating with
universities, public institutions, farmers, and crop consultants to translate agronomic data into practical
recommendations.  

## Research interests

There are several research areas that fascinate me. A short list of those would be: soil health, cover crops, soil fertility, and sustainable production systems.
